01 / About

Sepehr Shirazi

I'm a developer who learns by building. Most of my work is full-stack web, with Nuxt and Vue on the front, and databases and APIs behind them.

Lately I'm most curious about AI that does something useful: RAG systems that ground answers in real documents, and machine learning models on practical data.

I like understanding a problem properly, designing the system around it, and turning the idea into working software.
